content.text:
Reviewed revision `5a0f8b3`. Found three functional issues, all **P2**:

1. **Evicted sand patches remain retained indefinitely.** [ShaderComposer.cs:909](/Users/thomi/Projects/marvee/apps/simulator-godot/scripts/SceneKit/ShaderComposer.cs:909) caches strong references to geometries and their bound textures without eviction. Each sand patch creates a unique key, so exploring new dunes or resetting keeps accumulating resources despite the 64-tile limit. A targeted test retained all 192 geometries after garbage collection. Release unused variants when patches are discarded.

2. **The loading screen disappears before preparation finishes.** [AppController.cs:437](/Users/thomi/Projects/marvee/apps/simulator-godot/scripts/App/AppController.cs:437) hides the parent of the loading overlay before asynchronous preparation. A rendered run confirmed an invisible overlay and [blank content at 93%](/tmp/marvin-trail2154-loading-evidence/loading-at-93.png). The native [App.swift:517](/Users/thomi/Projects/marvee/apps/simulator-macos/Sources/MarvinSimulator/App.swift:517) has the same pattern. Keep the overlay visible until gameplay is revealed.

3. **CI reports shutdown hangs as successful exits.** [headless-modes.py:221](/Users/thomi/Projects/marvee/apps/simulator-godot/tools/ci/headless-modes.py:221) fails timeouts only when reports are missing. A process that writes its reports and then hangs returns success and “quit cleanly.” Injecting that timeout condition reproduced exit code 0. Every unexpected timeout should fail.

No confirmed security vulnerability in the inspected setup, asset-loading, CI, or runtime paths.

Godot build, core checks, facade mode, and loading smoke mode passed. Full native macOS and Windows end-to-end validation was not run. Working tree remains unchanged.
